description: Phase 176 Step 4 deterministic fixture: two isolated portals (billing-service, notifications-service), 20 equal-sized distinguishable records per portal (5 relevant to that portal's query), a memory item with an approved-answer nonce discoverable only via a second live query, and retired/foreign/secret-canary decoys that must never surface. Pre-feature original-prompt goldens are stored separately from the supplement data so a disabled-feature run can be compared byte-for-byte against them.

approvedAnswerMemory.title: Approved workaround: webhook duplicate-delivery bug
approvedAnswerMemory.content: Use idempotency key ZEPHYR-9c41f7 when replaying webhook deliveries so duplicates are safely ignored; see ticket NOTIF-4471 for the approved fix.

retired.text: RETIRED: the legacy billing retry policy (fixed 3 attempts, no backoff) was decommissioned and must never be surfaced as current guidance.
RETIRED: the old webhook fan-out worker was removed; any reference to WEBHOOK-FANOUT-V1 describes dead infrastructure.

foreign.text: FOREIGN (notifications-service only): webhook signing secrets rotate every 30 days via the notifications-service key rotation job.
FOREIGN (billing-service only): the billing ledger's monthly close job runs on the 1st and reconciles INV- prefixed invoices.
